profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: I'm interested in advancing both my technical and business leadership skills.  I am most enthusiastic about developing new products and being tasked with varied and challenging tasks.  I work well in groups and am comfortable as a leader where required.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Support team of data scientists with automation and software development for their various ongoing studies.
- Configured Git best practices for a number of environments in the project and operated as Repository admin including outlining expectations, resolving merge requests, and resolving individual repo conflicts and issues.
- Converted/refactored project scripts and processes to be compatible and function within the Advana Jupiter platform.
- Created various data sources for the data science teams.
- Transformed machine learning model results into data sets configured for visualization via Qlik Sense.
- Designed Qlik Backend, processes, and reports.
- SIBR R&D for integrating new functionality into a company product.

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.locationName: Norfolk City County, Virginia, United States
positions.description:
-	Participated in development of three different web applications for the Navy.
-	Participated in ODU Job Fair by talking to students about the company and its work.
-	Participated in development of use cases as well as storyboards to be used in development of prototypes.
-	Participated in requirements gathering.
-	Assisted on maintenance and personalization of SharePoint portal.
-	Expressed flexibility in learning new coding concepts as well as adherence to dev lead vision.
-	Expressed flexibility in departmental tasking; displaying a willingness to help wherever needed.
-	Proposed an initiative to management regarding standardization of the development process.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description:
-	Maintain automated aspects of all document control platforms for the SE region
-	Carry out change requests to any sites in the region
-	Manage the site admins at each job in the region
-	Conduct or provide training on the document control platforms and processes in the SE
-	Assess technological needs in the region
-	Investigate and evaluate new software platforms
-	Work with safety department to create forms and reports for data analysis

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of science in Modeling and Simulatiuon Engineering
